hero_subtitle: A non-profit organization (law 1901) helping populations in need: health, education, social services, and rural electrification.
about_intro: Under the name "Filonexia Actions", we bring our hospitality and fraternal generosity to populations in distress and destitution to give them the means to regain a sense of respect for life through gestures of support, aid, diverse funding, and infrastructure rehabilitation.
about_training: We organize care training workshops in the fields of health, rural development related to nutrition, education, and the modernization of towns and villages.
about_team: We have a multidisciplinary team across all business sectors. People who are ready to give their time, outside of their main activities, to bring their hospitality and development aid to less developed territories.
values_text: We advocate charity for all. Hospitality without borders, bringing hope and restoring a vision of success and excellence to populations who have nothing left to hope for. Building the mindsets of limited peoples and accompanying them to realize their dreams through concrete actions.
value_added_title: Our added value? Hospitality that changes relationships
value_added_1: We accompany elderly people who are not in nursing homes to help them in their daily lives so they can find solutions to their needs.
value_added_2: We assist in the rehabilitation of dilapidated and abandoned hospital centers (hospitals, clinics). We help equip these centers with reconditioned medical equipment.
value_added_3: We offer lighting and light to populations living in darkness for decades in their towns, villages, or municipalities by installing solar-powered streetlights.
value_added_4: We help schoolchildren in rural areas, where electricity and light are lacking, to have individual mini solar lamps allowing them to study their lessons after a day of school.
action_famine_text: Responding to famine and urgent food needs (e.g., students in university residences), stemming from a lack of structural organization and natural as well as anthropogenic disasters. We fight malnutrition, particularly among children and mothers, by carrying out activities that attempt to alleviate the causes of hunger, mortality, and morbidity.
action_eco_text: Promoting economic and community development by carrying out feeding programs through the creation of economic activity centers selling agricultural products harvested after various large-scale agricultural campaigns.
action_water_text: We are supporters of the fight against mortality due to the consumption of non-potable water. Thus, we initiate projects to install drinking water distribution parks through water boreholes.
action_tech_text: We bring new strategies and techniques to the rural population to benefit from the internet through the light of solar lamps and any other energy that would bring light to rural areas.
assets_title: Our strengths? A powerful and quality relationship network.
assets_1: Surrounded by experts, volunteers, and helpers ready to give their time, talents, and generosity for the accomplishment of all the major projects the association has for the 2030 horizon.
assets_2: We are ready to satisfy all those who fall under our corridor of action through the heart of help and development support. Those through training aid on mindset change and resilience due to various regional crises.
assets_3: A major player in cross-functional networking with reliable partners (foundations, international organizations, and associations) that can respond to the demands and needs of populations in distress and lack.
partner_title: Why choose us as your partner?
partner_1: Because we are composed of a wonderful team ready to give the best for others.
partner_2: Because our actions exceed the expectations of populations in need. A brand of hospitality mixed with excellence.
partner_3: We always believe that what we offer must live up to what we ourselves could accept.
partner_4: Because we realize that one of the ways to receive is to give with joy and happiness. Our lives will have meaning if we learn to change despair into hope and sadness into joy.
motto: Acting today making the impossible accessible for a better tomorrow.
contact_legal_1: Member of the Federation of Associations of France
report_intro: As part of its solidarity actions and fight against food insecurity, our association FILONEXIA ACTIONS organizes a free distribution of food intended for families in need.
report_partners_text: Products come from solidarity collections carried out every week (Monday and Friday) at partner stores: Franprix (Chennevières, Champigny, Nogent) and Carrefour Market (Bourg-la-Reine), with the support of Phenix. Food is redistributed notably in partnership with the Evangelical Church Mission KYRIA.
report_goals_text: Fight against food waste, supporting purchasing power, creating local social ties, and recovering unsold goods. Distributions take place with respect and fairness in Champigny-sur-Marne, Étampes, Paris, Brétigny-sur-Orge, and Angerville.
report_products_text: Fruits and vegetables, fresh produce, dairy, bakery, dry groceries, and meats. Each collection undergoes rigorous sorting to guarantee health safety.
report_perspectives_text: Development of new partnerships (CADA), acquisition of refrigeration equipment, increasing storage capacities, and organizing awareness workshops.
global_partners_text: We warmly thank our partners who support us daily in our solidarity actions:
action_hygiene_text: In partnership with ADOMA and the association Espoir pour une vie, we organize the regular distribution of food parcels and hygiene kits for vulnerable people, particularly in emergency shelters (Étampes).
report2_intro: In our commitment to providing access to basic infrastructure, Filonexia has installed solar lighting systems in underprivileged areas, allowing households to benefit from a sustainable and secure energy source.
